name: Glamour Photographer
source:
Just weeks after the loss of your father, a discovery in the attic changes everything: his vintage camera. It’s more than a relic; it’s a sign. You’re trading your ordinary life for a dream: to become a world-renowned photographer of captivating women, capturing them in their most authentic (and sometimes most natural!) forms.

Your journey kicks off when you reconnect with Anna, a childhood friend. One nervous request and one photoshoot later, your professional career is officially born.

Climb the ranks from an unknown amateur to a high-fashion icon. This comedic visual novel challenges you to scout everyday talent: employees, dancers, and even environmental activists, and transform them into household names.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4327630/Glamour_Photographer/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
父亲离世仅仅数周后，阁楼上的一次意外发现彻底改变了一切——那是他留下的复古相机。它不仅是一件遗物，更是一道启示。你决定告别平庸的日常生活去追逐梦想：成为享誉世界的魅力女性摄影大师，定格她们最真实（有时也是最“赤诚自然”！）的姿态。

当你与青梅竹马安娜重逢时，这段旅程正式拉开帷幕。一次忐忑不安的邀约与一场拍摄过后，你的职业摄影生涯就此诞生。

从默默无闻的业余新手一路攀升为高级时尚界传奇人物吧！在这部喜剧视觉小说中，你将发掘身边的素人璞玉——公司职员、舞者乃至环保活动家——并将她们打造成家喻户晓的明日之星。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4327630/Glamour_Photographer/]Steam[/url]]
